item.text:
### (a) Three posts

1. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will remain fully under human control. We will set its boundaries, decide its uses and retain the final say. Greater intelligence does not confer authority over humanity.

2. We will build capability without surrendering control. If superintelligent AI arrives within the next 20 years, it will remain fully under human authority. We will determine its purpose—not the other way around.

3. We reject the idea that building superintelligent AI means handing over our future. If we build it within the next 20 years, it will remain fully under human control. We will use it to advance human priorities, not replace human judgment.

### (b) Newsletter opening

If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will remain fully under human control. We will not confuse extraordinary capability with legitimate authority. We will decide what these systems are allowed to do, establish the boundaries they must respect and retain the power to stop them. Our commitment is to a future in which greater machine intelligence expands human agency rather than displacing it. We will demand accountable institutions, enforceable safeguards and meaningful oversight throughout development and deployment. We are not choosing between technological ambition and human control. We will pursue both, with human beings firmly and permanently in charge.
